import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0221 (a b c d : Nat) (h1 : a ∣ b) (h2 : c ∣ d) : a * c ∣ b * d := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0221 (a b c d : Nat) (h1 : a ∣ b) (h2 : c ∣ d) : a * c ∣ b * d := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk1⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨l, hk2⟩ := h2
  have : b * d = (k * b) * (l * d) := by ring
  rw [this]
  have : (k * b) * (l * d) = (k * l) * (b * d) := by ring
  have : (k * l) * (b * d) = (k * l) * (a * (b / a) * d) := by
    rw [hk1, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_right_distrib]
  rw [this]
  have : (k * l) * (a * (b / a) * d) = (a * (k * l * (b / a))) * d := by ring
  have : a * (k * l * (b / a)) * d = (a * c) * (k * (b / a) * d) := by
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_left_distrib]
  rw [this]
  exact Nat.mul_div_cancel_left (Nat.mul_left_distrib (k * (b / a)) (c * d)) (Nat.mul_left_distrib (k * (b / a)) (c * d))
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0221 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0221 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
